title: Meridian Construction - Corporate History and Personnel
text: Meridian Construction was founded in 2005 by a group of engineers. James Carter became CEO of Meridian on January 15, 2018, leading the company's expansion. Sarah Miller was hired by Meridian as a Safety Inspector on March 1, 2020. The massive Project Atlas began construction on June 10, 2022. A critical document, the Safety Report 2023, was filed with the city on May 5, 2023. Meridian Construction's headquarters is located in Seattle, WA.
